text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sakura Laurel's legs are in top condition. 
Heading into the Nakayama Kimpai, she has 
no worries left.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Cheered on by Sakura Chiyono O and Sakura 
Bakushin O, she gets fired up once more. 
Proudly declaring she'll take 1st place, 
she heads into the race.
